# S1: Checking the number of unique projids of decedents.
```{r}
DFFromS1 <- read.csv(here::here('inputs', 'NIAvalueUpdatedVersion_scaled_whole_decedents_dataset.csv'))
```

```{r}
cols <- c("gpath","tangles","amyloid","niareagansc")

DFFromS1 <- DFFromS1 %>%
  mutate(
    # At least one finite non-NA pathology value: decedent = 0; otherwise living = 1
    living_status = if_else(
      if_any(all_of(cols), ~ !is.na(.) & is.finite(.)),
      0L, 1L
    )
  )

cat(glue("The length of unique projid of DFFromS1 is {length(unique(DFFromS1$projid))} with the number of records of decedents / total number of records = {length(DFFromS1$living_status)}/{nrow(DFFromS1)}.\n")) 


```

```{r}
DT_filled1 <- DFFromS1 %>%
  arrange(projid, fu_year) %>%
  group_by(projid) %>%
  fill(all_of(cols), .direction = "downup") %>%
  ungroup()

complete4_1 <- DT_filled1 %>%
  filter(
    if_all(
      all_of(cols),
      ~ !is.na(.) & (!is.numeric(.) | is.finite(.))
    )
  )

cat(glue(
  "There are {nrow(complete4_1)} rows containing all four pathology values;",
  "Number of unique projid values: {n_distinct(complete4_1$projid)}\n"
))
```



```{r}
df1 <- read_csv(here::here('inputs', 'scaled_test_with_modifiedNIA_0725.csv'))
df2 <- read_csv(here::here('inputs', 'scaled_train_with_modifiedNIA_0725.csv'))
DFFromS2 <- bind_rows(df1, df2)
DFFromS2 <- DFFromS2 %>%
  mutate(
    # At least one finite non-NA pathology value: decedent = 0; otherwise living = 1
    living_status = if_else(
      if_any(all_of(cols), ~ !is.na(.) & is.finite(.)),
      0L, 1L
    )
  )
DFFromS2 %>%
  group_by(living_status) %>%
  summarise(
    n_rows = n(),
    n_unique_projid = n_distinct(projid),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
DT_filled2 <- DFFromS2 %>%
  arrange(projid, fu_year) %>%
  group_by(projid) %>%
  fill(all_of(cols), .direction = "downup") %>%
  ungroup()

complete4_2 <- DT_filled2 %>%
  filter(
    if_all(
      all_of(cols),
      ~ !is.na(.) & (!is.numeric(.) | is.finite(.))
    )
  )

cat(glue(
  "There are {nrow(complete4_2)} rows containing all four pathology values;",
  "Number of unique projid values: {n_distinct(complete4_2$projid)}\n"
))
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(glue)

ids1 <- unique(complete4_1$projid)
ids2 <- unique(complete4_2$projid)

incl <- all(ids1 %in% ids2)
missing_ids <- setdiff(ids2, ids1)

cat(glue(
         "Unique projid count for complete4_1: {length(ids1)}\n",
         "Unique projid count for complete4_2: {length(ids2)}\n",
         "Does complete4_2 include all IDs in complete4_1? {incl}\n",
         "Number of IDs in complete4_2 absent from complete4_1: {length(missing_ids)}\n"))

# To inspect missing IDs (first several dozen)
head(missing_ids, 50)

# Alternatively inspect missing rows with dplyr
anti_rows <- complete4_1 %>% anti_join(complete4_2, by = "projid")
nrow(anti_rows)
```
